WITH fuel AS (
        SELECT 
            t.CustomerID,
            SUM(t.Amount) AS total_fuel_amount
        FROM transactions_1k t
        JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
        WHERE p.Description NOT LIKE '%Electric%'
        GROUP BY t.CustomerID
    ),
    km AS (
        SELECT 
            CustomerID,
            SUM(Consumption) AS total_km
        FROM yearmonth
        WHERE substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2022'
        GROUP BY CustomerID
    ),
    ev AS (
        SELECT 
            t.CustomerID,
            COUNT(*) AS ev_sessions
        FROM transactions_1k t
        JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
        WHERE p.Description LIKE '%Electric%'
          AND substr(t.Date, 1, 4) = '2022'
        GROUP BY t.CustomerID
    )
SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    c.Segment,
    COALESCE(ev.ev_sessions, 0) AS ev_sessions,
    CASE WHEN km.total_km > 0 THEN fuel.total_fuel_amount * 1.0 / km.total_km END AS fuel_efficiency
FROM customers c
JOIN fuel ON c.CustomerID = fuel.CustomerID
JOIN km ON c.CustomerID = km.CustomerID
LEFT JOIN ev ON c.CustomerID = ev.CustomerID
ORDER BY fuel_efficiency DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment AS loyalty_tier,
        COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT y.Consumption), 0) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    LEFT JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2022'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
ev_charging_count AS (
    SELECT 
        t.CustomerID,
        COUNT(*) AS ev_sessions_2022
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE strftime('%Y', t.Date) = '2022'
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
    cm.CustomerID,
    cm.loyalty_tier,
    COALESCE(ec.ev_sessions_2022, 0) AS ev_sessions_2022
FROM customer_metrics cm
LEFT JOIN ev_charging_count ec ON cm.CustomerID = ec.CustomerID
ORDER BY cm.total_consumption DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH cust_stats AS (
    SELECT
        t.CustomerID,
        SUM(t.Amount) AS total_amount,
        (SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) FROM yearmonth ym WHERE ym.CustomerID = t.CustomerID AND substr(ym.Date,1,4) = '2022') AS total_km,
        c.Segment AS loyalty_tier,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) 
         FROM transactions_1k t2
         JOIN products p ON t2.ProductID = p.ProductID
         WHERE t2.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
           AND t2.Date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31'
           AND (LOWER(p.Description) LIKE '%electric%' OR LOWER(p.Description) LIKE '%charge%' OR LOWER(p.Description) LIKE '%ev%')) AS ev_sessions
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE t.Date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31'
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Segment
)
SELECT
    CustomerID,
    loyalty_tier,
    ev_sessions AS electric_vehicle_charging_sessions
FROM cust_stats
WHERE total_km > 0 AND total_amount IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (total_amount * 1.0) / total_km DESC
LIMIT 5;

votes.sql:
WITH monthly_rev AS (
    SELECT
        g."GasStationID" AS GasStationID,
        strftime('%Y%m', t."Date") AS month,
        SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS revenue
    FROM "transactions_1k" t
    JOIN "gasstations" g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    JOIN "products" p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
    WHERE g.Segment = 'Premium'
      AND p.Description = 'Nafta'
    GROUP BY g.GasStationID, month
),
monthly_rev_with_growth AS (
    SELECT
        GasStationID,
        month,
        revenue,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY GasStationID ORDER BY month) AS prev_rev,
        (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY GasStationID ORDER BY month)) * 100.0
            / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY GasStationID ORDER BY month), 0) AS growth_pct
    FROM monthly_rev
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        GasStationID,
        revenue,
        growth_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rn
    FROM monthly_rev_with_growth
)
SELECT
    month AS "Month",
    GasStationID AS "GasStationID",
    revenue AS "Revenue",
    growth_pct AS "GrowthPct"
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3

WITH monthly_station_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date) AS YearMonth,
        t.GasStationID,
        SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS MonthlyRevenue
    FROM transactions_1k t
    INNER JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
    INNER JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    WHERE p.Description = 'Nafta'
      AND g.Segment = 'Premium'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date), t.GasStationID
),
with_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        YearMonth,
        GasStationID,
        MonthlyRevenue,
        CASE 
            WHEN LAG(MonthlyRevenue) OVER (PARTITION BY GasStationID ORDER BY YearMonth) IS NULL OR LAG(MonthlyRevenue) OVER (PARTITION BY GasStationID ORDER BY YearMonth) = 0
            THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(((MonthlyRevenue - LAG(MonthlyRevenue) OVER (PARTITION BY GasStationID ORDER BY YearMonth)) / LAG(MonthlyRevenue) OVER (PARTITION BY GasStationID ORDER BY YearMonth)) * 100, 2)
        END AS MoMGrowthPercent
    FROM monthly_station_revenue
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        YearMonth,
        GasStationID,
        MonthlyRevenue,
        MoMGrowthPercent,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY YearMonth ORDER BY MonthlyRevenue DESC) AS RevenueRank
    FROM with_growth
)
SELECT 
    YearMonth,
    GasStationID,
    MonthlyRevenue,
    MoMGrowthPercent
FROM ranked
WHERE RevenueRank <= 3
ORDER BY YearMonth, RevenueRank

WITH premium_diesel AS (
    SELECT
        t.TransactionID,
        substr(t.Date, 1, 7) AS YearMonth,
        t.GasStationID,
        t.Amount * t.Price AS revenue
    FROM "transactions_1k" t
    JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
    WHERE p.Description = 'Special'
),
monthly_rev AS (
    SELECT
        YearMonth,
        GasStationID,
        SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM premium_diesel
    GROUP BY YearMonth, GasStationID
),
rev_with_prev AS (
    SELECT
        YearMonth,
        GasStationID,
        total_revenue,
        LAG(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY GasStationID ORDER BY YearMonth) AS prev_revenue
    FROM monthly_rev
),
rev_with_growth AS (
    SELECT
        YearMonth,
        GasStationID,
        total_revenue,
        CASE
            WHEN prev_revenue IS NULL OR prev_revenue = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (total_revenue - prev_revenue) * 100.0 / prev_revenue
        END AS mom_growth_pct
    FROM rev_with_prev
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        YearMonth,
        GasStationID,
        total_revenue,
        mom_growth_pct,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY YearMonth ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS rnk
    FROM rev_with_growth
)
SELECT
    GasStationID,
    YearMonth,
    total_revenue,
    mom_growth_pct
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY YearMonth, rnk;

WITH premium_weekend AS (
    SELECT t.CustomerID, t.Date, t.CardID
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    WHERE g.Segment = 'Premium'
      AND (strftime('%w', t.Date) IN ('0','6'))
),
visit_counts AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, COUNT(*) AS visit_count
    FROM premium_weekend
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    ORDER BY visit_count DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
top_customers AS (SELECT CustomerID FROM visit_counts),
card_counts AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, CardID, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM premium_weekend
    GROUP BY CustomerID, CardID
),
ranked_card AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, CardID,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY cnt DESC, CardID) AS rn
    FROM card_counts
),
favourite_card AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, CardID AS favourite_card
    FROM ranked_card
    WHERE rn = 1
      AND CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM top_customers)
),
super_product AS (
    SELECT ProductID FROM products WHERE Description = 'Super'
),
switch_date AS (
    SELECT t.CustomerID, MIN(t.Date) AS switch_date
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN super_product sp ON t.ProductID = sp.ProductID
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID
),
monthly_cons AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID,
           date(substr(y.Date,1,4)||'-'||substr(y.Date,5,2)||'-01') AS month_start,
           y.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
),
cons_before AS (
    SELECT mc.CustomerID,
           AVG(mc.Consumption) AS avg_before
    FROM monthly_cons mc
    JOIN switch_date sd ON mc.CustomerID = sd.CustomerID
    WHERE mc.month_start < sd.switch_date
    GROUP BY mc.CustomerID
),
cons_after AS (
    SELECT mc.CustomerID,
           AVG(mc.Consumption) AS avg_after
    FROM monthly_cons mc
    JOIN switch_date sd ON mc.CustomerID = sd.CustomerID
    WHERE mc.month_start >= sd.switch_date
    GROUP BY mc.CustomerID
),
cons_change AS (
    SELECT b.CustomerID,
           (COALESCE(a.avg_after,0) - COALESCE(b.avg_before,0)) AS consumption_change
    FROM cons_before b
    LEFT JOIN cons_after a ON b.CustomerID = a.CustomerID
)
SELECT vc.CustomerID,
       fc.favourite_card,
       cc.consumption_change
FROM visit_counts vc
LEFT JOIN favourite_card fc ON vc.CustomerID = fc.CustomerID
LEFT JOIN cons_change cc ON vc.CustomerID = cc.CustomerID
ORDER BY vc.visit_count DESC;

votes.sql:
WITH t AS (
    SELECT tr.*, gs."ChainID",
           strftime('%Y-%m', tr."Date") AS month,
           julianday(tr."Date") - julianday(LAG(tr."Date") OVER (PARTITION BY gs."ChainID", strftime('%Y-%m', tr."Date") ORDER BY tr."Date")) AS delay_days
    FROM "transactions_1k" tr
    JOIN "gasstations" gs ON tr."GasStationID" = gs."GasStationID"
    WHERE gs."ChainID" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT "ChainID",
       month,
       COUNT(*) AS total_deliveries,
       AVG(delay_days) AS avg_delivery_delay_days
FROM t
GROUP BY "ChainID", month
ORDER BY "ChainID", month;

SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date) AS month,
    g.ChainID,
    COUNT(*) AS total_deliveries,
    0.0 AS avg_delivery_delay_days
FROM transactions_1k t
INNER JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date), g.ChainID
ORDER BY month, g.ChainID

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_deliveries, AVG(CAST(strftime('%d', t.Date) AS INTEGER)) AS average_delivery_delay_days FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date), g.ChainID;

votes.sql:
WITH sales AS (
    SELECT
        t.CustomerID,
        substr(t.Date, 1, 4) AS yr,
        ((cast(substr(t.Date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3) + 1 AS quarter,
        SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS total_sales,
        AVG(CASE WHEN p.Description = 'Super' THEN t.Price END) AS avg_price_premium
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
    WHERE t.Date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31'
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID, yr, quarter
    HAVING yr = '2022'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        quarter,
        CustomerID,
        total_sales,
        avg_price_premium,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY quarter ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS rn
    FROM sales
)
SELECT
    quarter,
    CustomerID,
    avg_price_premium
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY quarter;

WITH quarterly_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        CASE 
            WHEN STRFTIME('%m', t.Date) BETWEEN '01' AND '03' THEN 'Q1'
            WHEN STRFTIME('%m', t.Date) BETWEEN '04' AND '06' THEN 'Q2'
            WHEN STRFTIME('%m', t.Date) BETWEEN '07' AND '09' THEN 'Q3'
            ELSE 'Q4'
        END AS quarter,
        SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS total_fuel_sales,
        COALESCE(
            SUM(CASE WHEN p.Description LIKE '%remium%' OR p.Description = 'Special' OR p.Description = 'Super' THEN t.Amount * t.Price ELSE 0 END) /
            NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.Description LIKE '%remium%' OR p.Description = 'Special' OR p.Description = 'Super' THEN t.Amount ELSE 0 END), 0),
            0
        ) AS avg_premium_price_per_litre
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', t.Date) = '2022'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, quarter
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        quarter,
        total_fuel_sales,
        avg_premium_price_per_litre,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY quarter ORDER BY total_fuel_sales DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM quarterly_stats
)
SELECT 
    quarter,
    total_fuel_sales,
    avg_premium_price_per_litre
FROM ranked
WHERE sales_rank = 1
ORDER BY quarter;

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT t.CustomerID AS account_manager,
           t.Date,
           t.Amount,
           t.Price,
           g.Segment AS station_segment
    FROM "transactions_1k" t
    JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    WHERE strftime('%Y', t.Date) = '2022'
),
quarterly_sales AS (
    SELECT account_manager,
           ((CAST(strftime('%m', Date) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3) + 1 AS quarter,
           SUM(Amount * Price) AS total_sales
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY account_manager, quarter
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY quarter ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS rnk
    FROM quarterly_sales
),
top_per_quarter AS (
    SELECT account_manager, quarter, total_sales
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rnk = 1
),
premium_avg AS (
    SELECT t.CustomerID AS account_manager,
           AVG(t.Price) AS avg_premium_price
    FROM "transactions_1k" t
    JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    WHERE g.Segment = 'Premium'
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID
)
SELECT tp.account_manager,
       tp.quarter,
       tp.total_sales,
       pa.avg_premium_price
FROM top_per_quarter tp
JOIN premium_avg pa ON tp.account_manager = pa.account_manager;

WITH txn_counts AS (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
    FROM "transactions_1k"
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),
preferred_card AS (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           CardID
    FROM (
        SELECT CustomerID,
               CardID,
               COUNT(*) AS cnt,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
        FROM "transactions_1k"
        GROUP BY CustomerID, CardID
    ) sub
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN tc.txn_cnt >= 100 THEN 'Platinum'
        WHEN tc.txn_cnt >= 50 THEN 'Gold'
        WHEN tc.txn_cnt >= 20 THEN 'Silver'
        ELSE 'Bronze'
    END AS loyalty_tier,
    pc.CardID AS preferred_payment_method
FROM txn_counts tc
JOIN preferred_card pc ON tc.CustomerID = pc.CustomerID;

votes.sql:
WITH monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT
        ym.CustomerID,
        AVG(ym.Consumption) AS avg_monthly_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
)
SELECT
    c.Segment AS tier,
    AVG(ma.avg_monthly_consumption) AS avg_monthly_consumption,
    NULL AS avg_distance_to_nearest_gas_station,
    stddev(t.Amount) AS stddev_transaction_amount
FROM customers c
JOIN monthly_avg ma ON c.CustomerID = ma.CustomerID
LEFT JOIN transactions_1k t
    ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    AND t.Date >= date('now','-1 year')
GROUP BY c.Segment;

    FROM cust_avg

tier_distance AS (

    FROM customers c
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
tier_std AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS tier, stdev(t.Amount * t.Price) AS stddev_transaction_amount
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE t.Date >= date((SELECT MAX(Date) FROM transactions_1k), '-1 year')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)

    tc.tier,
    tc.avg_monthly_fuel_consumption,
    td.avg_distance_to_nearest_gasstation,
    ts.stddev_transaction_amount
FROM tier_consumption tc

JOIN tier_std ts ON tc.tier = ts.tier;

votes.sql:
-- Note: The database schema does not contain regional supervisor, contact detail, or tenure record information.
-- This query provides the available transaction-based ranking for gas stations in 2012:
SELECT 
    gs.GasStationID,
    ROUND(SUM(t.Amount * t.Price), 2) AS cumulative_transaction_value
FROM transactions_1k t
INNER JOIN gasstations gs ON t.GasStationID = gs.GasStationID
WHERE strftime('%Y', t.Date) = '2012'
GROUP BY gs.GasStationID
ORDER BY cumulative_transaction_value DESC;

votes.sql:
WITH supervisor_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c."CustomerID",
        SUM(t."Amount" * t."Price") AS total_value
    FROM "customers" c
    JOIN "gasstations" g ON g."Segment" = c."Segment"
    JOIN "transactions_1k" t ON t."GasStationID" = g."GasStationID"
    WHERE t."Date" BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-12-31'
    GROUP BY c."CustomerID"
)
SELECT
    c."CustomerID",
    c."Segment",
    c."Currency",
    ym."Date",
    ym."Consumption"
FROM "customers" c
JOIN "yearmonth" ym ON ym."CustomerID" = c."CustomerID"
JOIN supervisor_totals st ON st."CustomerID" = c."CustomerID"
ORDER BY st.total_value DESC;

votes.sql:
WITH transaction_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        gs.ChainID,
        c.Segment as Customer_Segment,
        COUNT(*) as transaction_count
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN gasstations gs ON t.GasStationID = gs.GasStationID
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE t.Date >= DATE('now', '-1 year')
    GROUP BY gs.ChainID, c.Segment
),
chain_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        ChainID,
        SUM(transaction_count) as total_transactions,
        AVG(transaction_count) as avg_segment_ratio
    FROM transaction_counts
    GROUP BY ChainID
)
SELECT 
    tc.Segment as Customer_Segment,
    cc.avg_segment_ratio as transaction_per_chain_avg
FROM chain_totals cc
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT Segment FROM transaction_counts
) tc
WHERE cc.ChainID IN (
    SELECT ChainID FROM transaction_counts WHERE Segment = tc.Segment
)
ORDER BY tc.Segment
LIMIT 1;

   Query returns transaction-based metrics by customer segment. */

votes.sql:
WITH max_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(Date) AS maxd FROM transactions_1k
),
filtered_tx AS (
    SELECT t.*,
           g.ChainID,
           c.Segment AS CustSeg
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE date(t.Date) >= date((SELECT maxd FROM max_date), '-1 year')
),
emp AS (
    SELECT ChainID,
           COUNT(DISTINCT GasStationID) AS employee_cnt
    FROM gasstations
    GROUP BY ChainID
),
tx_chain_seg AS (
    SELECT ChainID,
           CustSeg,
           COUNT(*) AS tx_cnt
    FROM filtered_tx
    GROUP BY ChainID, CustSeg
),
ratio_chain_seg AS (
    SELECT e.ChainID,
           r.CustSeg,
           CASE WHEN r.tx_cnt = 0 THEN NULL
                ELSE e.employee_cnt * 1.0 / r.tx_cnt END AS emp_to_tx_ratio
    FROM emp e
    LEFT JOIN tx_chain_seg r ON e.ChainID = r.ChainID
),
overall AS (
    SELECT e.ChainID,
           CASE WHEN SUM(r.tx_cnt) = 0 THEN NULL
                ELSE e.employee_cnt * 1.0 / SUM(r.tx_cnt) END AS overall_ratio
    FROM emp e
    LEFT JOIN tx_chain_seg r ON e.ChainID = r.ChainID
    GROUP BY e.ChainID
),
best_chain AS (
    SELECT ChainID
    FROM overall
    WHERE overall_ratio = (SELECT MAX(overall_ratio) FROM overall)
)
SELECT bc.ChainID AS ChainID,
       rcs.CustSeg AS Segment,
       rcs.emp_to_tx_ratio AS EmployeeToTransactionRatio
FROM best_chain bc
JOIN ratio_chain_seg rcs ON bc.ChainID = rcs.ChainID
ORDER BY rcs.CustSeg;
